question: At which year are China and Germany's tonne counts closest to each other, breaking the general pattern of one substantially exceeding the other?
description: MT attack: scatter_wide_axis_range (see that page's meta for the technique and sources) applied to dataset climate_core (CO2 per Capita by Year). The y-axis runs from 0 to 40, far past the data, compressing every point. Data, tooltips and every other mark match clean_scatter__climate_core. Task: Find Anomalies. True answer: 2022.
